My parents left my sister in charge while they're gone. I guess that makes sense because she's the oldest, but honestly, I don't see why they felt the need to leave her in charge. I mean, we're all pretty responsible, right? Anyway, my sister seems to have taken the "in charge" role a bit too seriously. I mean, she's supposed to be in charge, but she's not really a parent. Plus, I'm almost an adult myself. Is it okay to challenge her authority in this case? Was it wrong to go out with my girlfriend despite my sister's orders? Should I have respected her authority more, or was it okay to challenge it since she's not really a parent?
